programme.title: Kiko
programme.desc: Kiko tells of a child of a goldfish who is very independent, even though he is an only child. Kiko who is always cheerful has four good friends, namely Lola the discus fish, Ting Ting the crab, Patino the catfish and Poli the betta fish. On the other hand, the antagonists, Karkus the catfish and Pupus the eel, always make Kiko's life chaotic. One day, the lake where Kiko lives is polluted due to the reckless acts of humans, causing Kiko and friends to turn into mutants.

programme.title: Kiko
programme.desc: Kiko, seekor anak ikan mas koki yang sangat mandiri, walaupun ia anak tunggal. Kiko selalu riang dan memiliki empat sahabat baik yaitu Lola si ikan diskus, Ting Ting si kepiting, Patino si ikan patin dan Poli si ikan cupang. Di sisi lain, sosok antagonis, Karkus si ikan lele dan Pupus si belut, selalu membuat ricuh kehidupan Kiko.

programme.title: Joe & Robot Kopi S1 E8
programme.desc: Pilus, who watched the video of Joe with Clara, realized that Clara was a daughter of a famous professor and seemed to be thinking about something while working on his laptop. Meanwhile, Clara and Joe arrive at the port, they decide to turn off the communication device so that the sound of the cellphone doesn't catch them.

programme.title: Joe & Robot Kopi S1 E8
programme.desc: Pilus yang menyaksikan video Joe bersama Clara, menyadari kalau Clara adalah putri profesor terkenal dan tampak memikirkan sesuatu sambil bekerja dengan laptopnya. Sementara itu, Clara dan Joe tiba di pelabuhan, mereka memutuskan untuk mematikan perangkat komunikasi agar bunyi hp tidak membuat mereka tertangkap.

programme.title: Ikatan Cinta Aldebaran & Andin
programme.desc: A special compilation of Aldebaran and Andin’s emotional love story, from misunderstandings and sacrifices to their unwavering fight for their family.

programme.title: Ikatan Cinta Aldebaran & Andin

programme.desc: Deeply hurt by her ex, Titi was desperately looking for ways to make him jealous. Until one day she meets a guy and instantly decides to marry him. Will her rash decision-making be worthwhile?

programme.title: Nikah Pada Pandangan Pertama
programme.desc: Sakit hati Titi terhadap mantan kekasihnya yang sudah berkhianat, Titi rela mencari cara untuk membuat mantannya cemburu. Sampai seuatu kebetulan ia bertemu seorang pria, menikah pada pandangan pertama. Apa mungkin pengenalan singkat mereka akan bertahan lama?

programme.title: Multi Love Marketing
programme.desc: Dodi adalah anggota salah satu MLM yang menggunakan ketampanannya untuk merekrut anggota lain. Sama halnya dengan Niken yang juga anggota MLM yang menggunakan kecantikannya demi merekrut anggota lain. Bagaimana jadinya ya jika Dodi bertemu dengan Niken ?

programme.title: Nikah Duluan

programme.title: Nikah Duluan
programme.desc: Seorang wanita muda sangat gembira ketika pacarnya akhirnya melamarnya. Namun, mereka menghadapi kesulitan karena ibunya tidak menyetujui hubungan mereka.

programme.desc: Tika's appointment as a permanent employee at the tax office was canceled due to betrayal and the position was given to Yuli, her friend. programme.title: Pay Later S1 E1
programme.desc: Penunjukan Tika sebagai pegawai tetap di kantor pajak dibatalkan karena adanya pengkhianatan, dan posisi tersebut diberikan kepada Yuli, temannya. The tournament is staged across multiple ASEAN countries rather than at a single host nation.

programme.title: ASEAN C'ship Hyundai Cup 2026

programme.title: Teasing Takagi-San S3, Ep 1
programme.desc: In the Season 3 premiere, Nishikata is determined to finally outsmart Takagi during a series of playful encounters involving grip-strength training, summer tans, and the first days of the new semester. However, Takagi always seems one step ahead, turning every challenge into another opportunity to tease him. Beneath their lighthearted rivalry, both begin to show subtle signs that their relationship is becoming more meaningful, blending comedy, romance, and everyday school life.

programme.title: Teasing Takagi-San S3, Ep 1
programme.desc: Pada episode pembuka musim ketiga, Nishikata kembali berusaha mengalahkan Takagi dalam berbagai tantangan sederhana, mulai dari latihan kekuatan genggaman tangan, membandingkan kulit yang terbakar matahari, hingga momen-momen di awal semester baru. Namun, kecerdikan Takagi selalu membuat Nishikata menjadi sasaran godaan yang menghibur. Di balik persaingan yang penuh canda, keduanya perlahan menunjukkan kedekatan yang semakin berkembang, menghadirkan kisah romantis remaja yang hangat dan penuh humor.

programme.title: Jhanak
programme.desc: Setelah kematian ibunya, Jhanak terpaksa menikahi tunangan sepupunya Arshi, Aniruddh, untuk melarikan diri dari penguntitnya, Tejas. Meskipun Aniruddh dan Arshi telah bersama selama tujuh tahun, Jhanak memasuki kehidupan mereka dalam keadaan yang menyedihkan dan mulai bekerja sebagai pembantu di rumah tangga Bose. Sementara beberapa anggota keluarga memperlakukannya dengan baik, yang lain terus-menerus menghina dan meremehkannya.

programme.title: Jhanak
programme.desc: After her mother’s death, Jhanak is forced to marry her cousin Arshi’s fiancé, Aniruddh, to escape her stalker, Tejas. Although Aniruddh and Arshi have been together for seven years, Jhanak enters their lives under distressing circumstances and begins working as a maid in the Bose household. While some family members treat her kindly, others constantly insult and belittle her.

programme.title: Sayali
programme.desc: Udne Ki Aasha tells the story of Sachin and Sailee, a middle-class couple, as they navigate the complexities of their relationship. The story centers on Sailee’s struggles as she faces resistance from her husband and her efforts to inspire change not only for their own growth but also for the well-being of their entire family.

programme.title: Sayali
programme.desc: Udne Ki Aasha mengisahkan kehidupan kelas menengah Sachin dan Sailee saat mereka menghadapi kompleksitas hubungan mereka. Cerita ini berpusat pada perjuangan Sailee saat ia menghadapi hambatan berupa suami yang menolak dan upayanya untuk menginspirasi perubahan, bukan hanya untuk pertumbuhan mereka sendiri, tetapi juga untuk kesejahteraan seluruh keluarga mereka.

programme.title: Jaane Anjaane
programme.desc: A smart journalist Reet and hot-headed Raghav enter an arranged marriage through the 'Aata Sata' custom to secure their siblings' happiness. Their relationship of convenience faces unexpected turns.

programme.title: Jaane Anjaane
programme.desc: Reet, seorang jurnalis cerdas, dan Raghav yang temperamental, menikah melalui perjodohan berdasarkan adat ‘Aata Sata’ demi menjamin kebahagiaan saudara-saudara mereka. Hubungan mereka yang didasari kepentingan ini menghadapi lika-liku yang tak terduga.

programme.title: Teri Meri Doriyaann
programme.desc: The fate of the three Brar cousins Angad, Garry and Veer are linked with the three Monga sisters Sahiba, Seerat and Keerat. Sahiba is the hardworking and independent second daughter of the Monga family. She is an artist and earns money for her family by selling her art. Seerat, the eldest Monga sister, is pampered by her mother, Santosh, for her beauty. Santosh dreams of getting Seerat married to a rich man. As fate would have it, Angad falls in love with Seerat. However, Seerat is manipulated by Garry and his fake love. On Seerat and Angad's wedding day, Seerat runs away with Garry.

programme.title: Teri Meri Doriyaann
programme.desc: Nasib tiga sepupu Brar Angad, Garry dan Veer dikaitkan dengan tiga adik Monga Sahiba, Seerat dan keerat. Sahiba adalah anak perempuan kedua keluarga Monga yang rajin dan bebas. Dia seorang artis dan mendapat wang untuk keluarganya dengan menjual seni beliau. Seerat, kakak Monga yang tertua, dimanjakan oleh ibunya, Santosh, kerana kecantikannya. Santosh bermimpi untuk berkahwin dengan Seerat dengan seorang lelaki kaya. Seperti takdirnya, Angad jatuh cinta dengan Seerat. Walau bagaimanapun, Seerat dimanipulasi oleh Garry dan cinta palsu beliau. Pada hari perkahwinan Seerat dan Angad, Seerat melarikan diri dengan Garry.

programme.desc: Ben Fogle travels to China to explore its sights, meet its people, and uncover its true story. He examines 3000 years of history from Imperial rule through Communist revolution to modern economic transformation and mega-cities.

Ia menelusuri 3.000 tahun sejarah Tiongkok, mulai dari masa kekaisaran, revolusi komunis, hingga transformasi ekonomi modern dan kemunculan kota-kota megapolitan.

programme.title: The Blood Brothers
programme.desc: Assassin Chang and his brother Hung meet up with a soldier, Mu. Together, they form a small mountain army, but when Hung's wife arrives, emotions swell, and Mu leaves for the army. After long, Mu summons his friends to join him, but all the while, he has longed for Hung's wife, and tries to have Hung murdered. This treason forces Hung to take up arms against his former comrade.

programme.title: The Story Of Sue San
programme.desc: Wang is the son of a respected government official whereas Sue San is a famous prostitute. Although they love each other and seem to be perfectly matched, the two are worlds apart when it comes to social ranking.

programme.title: The Story Of Sue San
programme.desc: Wang adalah putra pejabat pemerintah yang dihormati, sedangkan Sue San adalah seorang wanita penghibur nan terkenal. Meskipun dan terlihat cocok dan saling mencintai, keduanya sangat berbeda dalam tingkatan sosial.

programme.title: Four Riders
programme.desc: This prime example of director/co-writer Chang Cheh's mastery takes place right after the Korean War, as a kung-fu master, combat instructor, explosives expert, and missle specialist heroically represent the Book of Revelation's four riders against murder, corruption, jealous and greed.

programme.title: Sunset
programme.desc: A car load of girls meets a car load of boys, and Ching Li and Paul Chin Pei fall in love. Yet the film turns out to be more like a Shakespearian tragedy than a beach-babe party.

programme.title: Sunset
programme.desc: Saat mobil yang ditumpangi sejumlah gadis berpapasan dengan mobil yang ditumpangi beberapa pria, Ching Li dan Paul Chin Pei jatuh cinta. Namun, kisah cinta mereka tidak berjalan mulus.

programme.title: Purple Darts
programme.desc: A girl vows to take revenge for her parents who were murdered by four outlaws when she was only a baby. To do so, she trains hard at martial arts and teams up with a swordsman and a couple to finally kill them all.

programme.title: Purple Darts
programme.desc: Seorang gadis bersumpah akan membalas dendam atas kematian orang tuanya oleh empat penjahat saat ia masih bayi. Ia pun berlatih seni bela diri, serta bekerja sama dengan seorang pendekar pedang dan suatu pasangan.

programme.title: The Adulteress
programme.desc: In the waning day of the Ching Dynasty, the son of the local magistrate murdered a peddler and raped his wife. The wife had been framed for her husband's murder by the rapist.

programme.title: The Adulteress
programme.desc: Pada masa kemunduran Dinasti Ching, putra dari hakim lokal membunuh seorang pedagang keliling dan memperkosa istrinya. Sang istri dijebak atas pembunuhan suaminya oleh sang pemerkosa.

programme.title: King Gambler
programme.desc: A master gambler loses his memory and is befriended by a street hustler who discovers his supernatural gambling abilities.

programme.title: Black Magic 2
programme.desc: Doctor Sing is puzzled by the strange symptoms of his patients and asks his friend for help. The sickness is apparently caused by a black magic that is casted by a wicked man Kong.

programme.title: Black Magic 2
programme.desc: Dokter Sing merasa bingung dengan gejala-gejala aneh yang dialami pasiennya dan meminta bantuan pada temannya. Penyakit tersebut rupanya disebabkan oleh ilmu hitam yang dilakukan oleh seorang pria jahat bernama Kong.

programme.title: Flying Guillotine 2
programme.desc: The emperor's reign of terror expands. Heroic outlaw Ma Teng joins a squad of female rebels, whose leader is torn between family loyalties.

programme.title: Men From The Monastery
programme.desc: When the "godfather of the kung-fu film" Chang Cheh decided to tell their stories with Alexander Fu Sheng, Chen Kuan-tai, and Chi Kuan-chun in the roles, it was cause for celebration. This film is one of the most beloved in the director's filmography. Each hero is given his own story, when they all come together in a final, day-long battle with hundreds of troops, the effect is unforgettable.

programme.title: Monkey Kung Fu
programme.desc: A disgraced former Kung Fu expert makes a living as a merchant with the help of a hot headed friend. When the men are harassed by gangsters, the merchant decided to teach his friend monkey boxing so they can defend their business.

programme.title: Shaolin Intruders
programme.desc: Shaolin Temple becomes suspect when several clan leaders are robbed and killed by the deadly Shaolin Palm technique.Shaolin Temple becomes suspect when several clan leaders are robbed and killed by the deadly Shaolin Palm technique.

programme.title: Shaolin Intruders
programme.desc: Shaolin Temple becomes suspect when several clan leaders are robbed and killed by the deadly Shaolin Palm technique.Shaolin Temple becomes suspect when several clan leaders are robbed and killed by the deadly Shaolin Palm technique.

programme.title: Hong Kong 73
programme.desc: Back in 1973 the stock market was skyrocketing, but HK's social issues continued to worsen. TVB and Shaw Bros' biggest stars come together for this ingenious tongue-in-cheek tale.

programme.title: Hong Kong 73
programme.desc: Di tahun 1973, bursa saham meroket, namun masalah-masalah sosial di Hong Kong terus memburuk. Bintang-bintang besar TVB dan Shaw Brothers bersatu dalam kisah yang lucu ini.

programme.title: The Long Chase
programme.desc: Yueh Hua stars as an assassin who flees after killing a hated prime minister, with Lo Lieh as the relentless imperial guard who pursues him to a remote village being terrorized by bandits.

programme.title: Tropicana Interlude
programme.desc: Ping and Su are lovers who operate a travel agency specializing in Southeast Asian holidays. Tung, a school mistress, and her students join a guided tour lead by Ping.

programme.title: Tropicana Interlude
programme.desc: Ping dan Su adalah sepasang kekasih yang mengelola agen perjalanan khusus liburan ke Asia Tenggara. Seorang kepala sekolah bernama Tung beserta murid-muridnya bergabung dalam tur yang dipimpin oleh Ping.

programme.title: The Snake Prince
programme.desc: Ti Lung who lives on the Snake Mountain of Kwangsi with his brothers the Black Snake and the Yellow Snake, have been trying to turn into humans for a thousand years.

programme.title: The Snake Prince
programme.desc: Ti Lung yang hidup di Gunung Ular Kwangsi bersama dengan saudaranya, Ular Hitam dan Ular Kuning, telah berusaha untuk berubah menjadi manusia selama seribu tahun.

programme.title: The Fantastic Magic Baby
programme.desc: In The Fantastic Magic Baby, director Chang Che weaves a wild and woolly yarn about how the legendary Monkey King and Goddess of Mercy battle and defeat the child god Hung Hai-erh then point him down the road to righteousness.

programme.title: The Cave Of Silken Web
programme.desc: The 3rd part of Shaw Bros' Journey To The West sees sex and spectacle combine as our heroes are trapped by the seductive 7 Spiders, hellbent on achieving immortality by eating monks!

programme.title: The Cave Of Silken Web
programme.desc: Bagian ke-3 dari film Journey To The West produksi Shaw Brothers ini mengikuti perjuangan para jagoan kita saat dijebak oleh 7 siluman laba-laba penggoda, yang bertekad untuk meraih keabadian dengan memakan para biksu!

programme.title: The Black Falcon
programme.desc: Zhang is a Bond-like international spy who must find the headquarters of a villainous crime organization by seducing their boss' daughter, Julie Tan.

programme.title: Hex
programme.desc: A sickly wife and maid conspire to kill her beastly husband, leading to a string of spooky twists and turns.

programme.title: Hex
programme.desc: Seorang istri yang sakit parah bekerjasama dengan asisten rumah tangganya untuk membunuh sang suami yang kasar. Namun, hal ini menyebabkan serangkaian kejadian mengerikan.

programme.title: The Killer
programme.desc: A disillusioned assassin accepts one last hit in hopes of using his earnings to restore the vision of a singer he accidentally blinded.

programme.title: The Killer
programme.desc: Seorang pembunuh yang kecewa menerima satu serangan terakhir dengan harapan dapat menggunakan penghasilannya untuk mengembalikan penglihatan seorang penyanyi yang secara tidak sengaja dibutakannya.

programme.title: The Emperor And The Minister
programme.desc: The Emperor Qianlong is not the legitimate successor to the throne at birth, but he only learns the truth when two senior members of a subversive anti-government secret organisation contact him years later.

programme.title: The Emperor And The Minister
programme.desc: Kaisar Qianlong bukanlah penerus takhta yang sah sejak lahir, tetapi ia baru mengetahui kebenarannya saat dua anggota senior organisasi rahasia anti-pemerintah menghubunginya beberapa tahun kemudian.

programme.title: Crippled Avengers
programme.desc: Three men who have been physically disabled by an evil warlord and his physically-disabled son become friends and learn kung fu so that they can seek revenge with help from an elderly martial-arts teacher and his mentally-disabled pupil.

programme.title: Rear Entrance
programme.desc: Mrs Xu is childless and watches a lonely little girl playing at the rear entrance from afar every day. She warmly nurtures the girl and even adopts her from her uncaring parent.

programme.title: Rear Entrance

programme.title: That Fiery Girl

programme.title: That Fiery Girl
programme.desc: The bandits of Hulu Valley murder the chief of Mei Clan while searching for a treasure map.

programme.title: The Monkey Goes West
programme.desc: Another film inspired by the Chinese classic tale Journey to the West. This memorable version presents a unique interpretation with humour, action, and fantasy galore.

programme.title: The Monkey Goes West
programme.desc: Film mengesankan yang diangkat dari kisah klasik Perjalanan Ke Barat ini menampilkan interpretasi nan unik yang dibumbui dengan humor, aksi laga dan kisah fantasi.

programme.title: The Spiritual Boxer

programme.title: The 5 Billion Dollar Legacy

programme.title: Le Horla
programme.desc: A man moves with his family in a new apartment and starts to feel a strange presence around him. Is he mad or is there really something ?

programme.title: Nightmare Alley: Possession
programme.desc: A grifter working his way up from low-ranking carnival worker to lauded psychic medium matches wits with a psychologist bent on exposing him.

programme.title: Nightmare Alley: Possession
programme.desc: Seorang penipu yang berusaha naik dari pekerja karnaval rendahan menjadi medium paranormal terkenal harus adu kecerdikan dengan seorang psikolog yang bertekad membongkar tipu dayanya.

programme.title: Take Me Home
programme.desc: After losing his memory from an accident, Tan tried to find his identity. Eventually, he found something that led him back to his home. But the more he knows, the more he fears of their secrets of his so-called family.

programme.title: Take Me Home
programme.desc: Setelah kehilangan ingatan karena kecelakaan, Tan berusaha mencari jati dirinya. Ketika dia akhirnya kembali ke rumah, rahasia-rahasia yang perlahan terkuak membuatnya merasa takut dan ragu akan keluarganya itu.

programme.title: Red Dog
programme.desc: Based on the legendary true story of the Red Dog who united a disparate local community while roaming the Australian outback in search of his long lost master.

programme.title: Red Dog
programme.desc: Berdasarkan kisah nyata legendaris tentang Anjing Merah yang menyatukan masyarakat lokal yang berbeda saat menjelajahi pedalaman Australia untuk mencari tuannya yang telah lama hilang.

programme.title: Borrego
programme.desc: Borrego follows a young botanist who relocates to a small desert town to study an invasive plant species. She must fight for her survival when she's kidnapped by an inexperienced drug mule after his ultralight plane crashes in the desert.

programme.title: Borrego
programme.desc: Borrego mengikuti seorang ahli botani muda yang pindah ke kota kecil gurun untuk mempelajari spesies tanaman invasif. Dia harus berjuang untuk bertahan hidup ketika dia diculik oleh seorang pengedar narkoba yang tidak berpengalaman setelah pesawat ultralightnya jatuh di padang pasir.

programme.title: Nightmare Alley: Possession
programme.desc: A grifter working his way up from low-ranking carnival worker to lauded psychic medium matches wits with a psychologist bent on exposing him.

programme.title: Nightmare Alley: Possession
programme.desc: Seorang penipu yang berusaha naik dari pekerja karnaval rendahan menjadi medium paranormal terkenal harus adu kecerdikan dengan seorang psikolog yang bertekad membongkar tipu dayanya.

programme.title: Viking Quest
programme.desc: A young peasant boy is taken from his home by Viking raiders and raised as one of them. But when a legendary dragon attacks his clan, he discovers that he is the Viking hero destined to stop the dragons from destroying the world.

programme.title: Viking Quest
programme.desc: Seorang anak petani dibawa pergi dari rumahnya oleh para perampok Viking dan dibesarkan sebagai salah satu dari mereka. Namun, ketika seekor naga legendaris menyerang sukunya, ia menyadari bahwa dirinya adalah pahlawan Viking yang ditakdirkan untuk menghentikan para naga agar tidak menghancurkan dunia.

programme.title: Angels In The Snow
programme.desc: Charles and Judith Montgomery hope a Christmas getaway will help repair their strained family relationships, but a severe snowstorm leaves them isolated in their mountain cabin. When a stranded family arrives seeking shelter, the Montgomerys are forced to share their home and confront the tensions that have been pulling them apart. Through compassion, unexpected friendships, and a touch of holiday magic, Angels in the Snow tells a heartfelt story about forgiveness, rediscovering love, and the possibility of a second chance.

programme.title: Angels In The Snow
programme.desc: Charles dan Judith Montgomery berharap liburan Natal di kabin pegunungan dapat memperbaiki hubungan keluarga yang mulai retak. Namun, badai salju besar membuat mereka terisolasi dan harus menerima sebuah keluarga yang mengalami kecelakaan di jalan untuk berlindung bersama. Kehadiran para tamu tersebut perlahan membuka mata keluarga Montgomery terhadap kasih sayang, pengampunan, dan pentingnya saling mendukung. Angels in the Snow menghadirkan kisah keluarga yang hangat tentang harapan, cinta, dan kesempatan untuk memulai kembali.

programme.title: Love Is Blind
programme.desc: Singles who want to be loved for who they are, rather than what they look like, have signed up for a less-conventional approach to modern dating.

programme.title: Hair Brained
programme.desc: Child prodigy Eli Pettifog earns admission to an elite university at just fourteen years old, but his exceptional intellect does not make social life any easier. Struggling to connect with his classmates, Eli finds an unexpected mentor in Leo Searly, a quirky professor whose own career has seen better days. programme.title: Hours

programme.title: American Muscle
programme.desc: Setelah menjalani masa tahanan selama 10 tahun, seorang mantan narapidana memiliki waktu 24 jam untuk membalas dendam pada orang-orang yang memasukkannya ke dalam penjara.

programme.desc: From the enigmatic decline of the Inca Empire and the engineering marvel of Machu Picchu to the possibility of Viking voyages deep into North America and controversial theories surrounding Indonesia's Gunung Padang, this episode investigates the enduring mysteries of history's greatest kingdoms. Through archaeological discoveries, historical evidence, and expert insights, William Shatner examines what these remarkable civilizations reveal about humanity's forgotten past.

programme.title: The UnXplained S8, Ep 6
programme.desc: William Shatner menelusuri berbagai misteri di balik bangkit dan runtuhnya kerajaan-kerajaan besar dunia. Mulai dari penyebab kemunduran Kekaisaran Inca dan keajaiban Machu Picchu, dugaan pelayaran bangsa Viking hingga ke Amerika Utara, hingga teori mengenai situs Gunung Padang di Indonesia yang memicu perdebatan di kalangan arkeolog. Dengan memadukan temuan arkeologi, bukti sejarah, dan pendapat para ahli, episode ini mengungkap bagaimana warisan peradaban kuno masih menyimpan banyak teka-teki yang belum terpecahkan.

programme.title: Malaysia's Horse Archers
programme.desc: Malaysia's Horse Archers follows a passionate community dedicated to reviving the ancient art of horseback archery, a discipline that once played an important role in warfare and hunting. Through intensive training, cultural traditions, and demonstrations of remarkable skill, the documentary reveals how modern riders strive to preserve this historic practice while introducing it to new generations. Blending history, sport, and heritage, the film offers a fascinating look at one of Malaysia's most distinctive living traditions.

programme.title: Malaysia's Horse Archers
programme.desc: Malaysia's Horse Archers mengikuti komunitas pecinta panahan berkuda yang berupaya menghidupkan kembali salah satu tradisi bela diri tertua di Malaysia. Melalui latihan intensif, pengenalan sejarah, serta pelestarian nilai-nilai budaya, dokumenter ini memperlihatkan bagaimana keterampilan memanah dari atas kuda diwariskan kepada generasi baru. Dipadukan dengan demonstrasi teknik yang memukau dan kisah para pelestarinya, film ini menghadirkan gambaran menarik tentang perpaduan antara sejarah, olahraga, dan identitas budaya Malaysia.

Hidden Cities Extreme S1, Ep 3
programme.desc: In the first season of Hidden Cities Extreme, Simon Yin travels across Asia in search of unforgettable experiences that go far beyond conventional tourism. From learning the art of Filipino stick fighting (Eskrima), racing buffaloes in Indonesia, tasting unusual local delicacies, to embracing centuries-old traditions, he immerses himself in each culture through daring, hands-on challenges. Combining adventure, travel, and cultural discovery, the series offers an exciting look at Asia's hidden worlds from an entirely new perspective.

programme.title: Hidden Cities Extreme S1, Ep 3
programme.desc: Musim pertama Hidden Cities Extreme mengikuti Simon Yin menjelajahi berbagai negara di Asia untuk mencoba langsung pengalaman-pengalaman yang menantang sekaligus memperkenalkan kekayaan budaya setempat. Mulai dari mempelajari seni bela diri Eskrima di Filipina, mengikuti balap kerbau di Indonesia, hingga mencicipi makanan khas yang tidak biasa, setiap perjalanan menghadirkan sisi budaya yang autentik dan jarang terlihat oleh wisatawan. Dengan memadukan petualangan, tantangan ekstrem, dan eksplorasi budaya, serial ini mengajak penonton melihat Asia dari sudut pandang yang berbeda.

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen S24: Last State
programme.desc: Dua finalis terakhir harus mengatasi kekurangan dan mengambil kendali tim masing-masing untuk keluar sebagai pemenang dan membuktikan kepada Chef Ramsay bahwa mereka memiliki kemampuan untuk menang; pada akhirnya, pintu hanya akan terbuka untuk satu koki.

programme.title: MasterChef S16: Pitch To Plate
programme.desc: Chefs compete in their first team challenge for the starting lineup. They partner with U.S. Soccer Federation to serve lunch to 101 kids from the field. With a guest judge and Gordon Ramsay as goalkeeper, one team wins immunity.

programme.title: MasterChef S16: Pitch To Plate
programme.desc: Para koki berkompetisi dalam tantangan tim pertama mereka untuk memperebutkan posisi di tim inti. Mereka bekerja sama dengan Federasi Sepak Bola AS untuk menyajikan makan siang kepada 101 anak dari lapangan. Dengan juri tamu dan Gordon Ramsay sebagai penjaga gawang, satu tim akan memenangkan kekebalan.

programme.title: A Quiet Place: Day One
programme.desc: Set on the first day of the alien invasion, A Quiet Place: Day One follows Sam, a terminally ill woman whose routine trip to New York City turns into a desperate fight for survival when deadly creatures descend upon the city. Forced to remain silent to avoid detection, she forms an unlikely bond with fellow survivor Eric as they navigate the devastated streets in search of safety. Blending relentless suspense with emotional storytelling, the film explores courage, compassion, and the resilience of the human spirit in the face of unimaginable terror.

programme.title: A Quiet Place: Day One
programme.desc: Mengisahkan hari pertama invasi makhluk asing yang memburu mangsa berdasarkan suara, A Quiet Place: Day One mengikuti perjalanan Sam, seorang wanita yang mengidap penyakit terminal, ketika kunjungannya ke New York City berubah menjadi perjuangan hidup dan mati. Di tengah kepanikan dan kehancuran kota, ia bersama Eric, seorang penyintas yang baru dikenalnya, harus bertahan dengan tetap menjaga kesunyian agar tidak menjadi sasaran makhluk mematikan tersebut. Memadukan ketegangan tanpa henti dengan drama emosional, film ini menghadirkan kisah tentang keberanian, empati, dan harapan di tengah situasi yang paling mengerikan.

programme.title: Celebrity Wheel Of... S4, Ep 9
programme.desc: Celebrity Wheel of Fortune welcomes celebrity contestants to spin the world's most famous wheel and solve word puzzles for a chance to win up to $1 million.

programme.title: Celebrity Wheel Of... S4, Ep 9
programme.desc: Celebrity Wheel of Fortune menyambut para kontestan selebriti untuk memutar roda paling terkenal di dunia dan memecahkan teka-teki kata untuk kesempatan memenangkan hadiah hingga $1 juta.

programme.title: Sheriff Country S1: Crucible 1
programme.desc: After a father and son flee a secluded ranch run by one of Edgewater's most power families, Mickey investigates disturbing allegations of abuse and uncovers dangerous secrets, which leads to a tense standoff and confrontation.

programme.title: Sheriff Country S1: Crucible 1
programme.desc: Setelah seorang ayah dan anak melarikan diri dari sebuah peternakan terpencil yang dikelola oleh salah satu keluarga paling berpengaruh di Edgewater, Mickey menyelidiki tuduhan pelecehan yang meresahkan dan mengungkap rahasia berbahaya, yang menyebabkan kebuntuan dan konfrontasi yang meneggangkan.

programme.title: Fire Country S4: The Dirt
programme.desc: When a red flag warning sets the stage for a volatile day, a turf war between Station 42 and neighboring Drake County comes to a head.

programme.title: Fire Country S4: The Dirt
programme.desc: Ketika peringatan bahaya kebakaran (red flag warning) menjadi pemicu hari yang penuh gejolak, perang wilayah antara Stasiun 42 dan wilayah tetangga, Drake County, mencapai puncaknya.

programme.title: Family Feud, Ep 54
programme.desc: Steve Harvey hosts two families competing to guess survey answers. Players face off to pass or play, and the winning team advances to a bonus round for a chance to earn extra cash.

programme.title: Family Feud, Ep 54
programme.desc: Steve Harvey memandu dua keluarga yang saling menebak jawaban survei. Mereka berebut peluang pass atau play, dan keluarga pemenang maju ke babak bonus untuk meraih hadiah uang tunai.

programme.title: Celebrity Family Feud S11, Ep 5
programme.desc: Steve Harvey hosts celebrities and their families on “Family Feud,” competing to guess top survey answers and win money for charity in a lively, audience-filled show in Los Angeles.

programme.title: Celebrity Family Feud S11, Ep 5
programme.desc: Steve Harvey memandu selebritas dan keluarganya bersaing menebak jawaban paling populer di “Family Feud,” berlomba meraih uang untuk amal dalam kompetisi seru di Los Angeles.

programme.title: The Goldbergs S4: The Day After
programme.desc: A TV movie freaks out Barry while Erica and Adam use mother's day gifts to get what they want.

programme.title: The Goldbergs S4: The Day After
programme.desc: Sebuah film TV membuat Barry ketakutan, sementara Erica dan Adam menggunakan hadiah Hari Ibu untuk mendapatkan apa yang mereka inginkan.

programme.title: Matlock S1: Friends
programme.desc: As Matty takes on a complex legal case, unexpected revelations place one of her closest relationships under intense pressure. While navigating difficult ethical choices inside and outside the courtroom, she must determine whether loyalty to a friend should outweigh the truth. Meanwhile, the team continues to unravel personal and professional challenges that could have lasting consequences. Friends delivers an engaging blend of legal drama, emotional conflict, and compelling character development.

programme.title: Matlock S1: Friends
programme.desc: Matty menangani sebuah perkara hukum yang perlahan berkembang menjadi konflik pribadi ketika fakta-fakta baru menguji hubungan dengan seseorang yang telah lama dikenalnya. Di tengah penyelidikan dan persidangan yang penuh tekanan, ia dihadapkan pada pilihan sulit antara mempertahankan kesetiaan kepada seorang sahabat atau memperjuangkan kebenaran. Sementara itu, anggota tim lainnya juga menghadapi tantangan yang memengaruhi kehidupan pribadi maupun profesional mereka. Episode "Friends" menghadirkan drama hukum yang dipadukan dengan konflik emosional serta perkembangan karakter yang semakin mendalam.

programme.title: Shark Tank S16, Ep 9 (Hits Now)
programme.desc: Entrepreneurs pitch innovative businesses and products to the Sharks, seeking investment and mentorship to grow their ventures. Season 16 also marks Mark Cuban’s final season as a main Shark.

programme.title: Shark Tank S16, Ep 9 (Hits Now)
programme.desc: Para pengusaha mempresentasikan bisnis dan produk inovatif kepada para Sharks untuk mendapatkan investasi dan bimbingan. Musim ke-16 juga menjadi musim terakhir Mark Cuban sebagai Shark utama.

programme.title: Sandokan: The Malaysian Tiger (Hits Now)
programme.desc: Sandokan and his crew board a ship and free a captive, who is convinced the pirate is the warrior from an old prophecy. Landing in Labuan in disguise, Sandokan meets Marianne, the consul's daughter and clashes with Brooke, a pirate hunter.

programme.title: Sandokan: The Malaysian Tiger (Hits Now)
programme.desc: Sandokan dan krunya menaiki sebuah kapal dan membebaskan seorang tawanan, yang yakin bahwa bajak laut itu adalah prajurit dari ramalan kuno. Mendarat di Labuan dengan menyamar, Sandokan bertemu Marianne, putri konsul, dan berkonflik dengan Brooke, seorang pemburu bajak laut.

programme.title: The Grey Men
programme.desc: The film's story unfolds in the fictional country of Laika and in Hong Kong, China. A police academy student who has not yet graduated, Ashan (played by Gu Bin), is tasked with a dangerous mission. He helps the criminal organization by eliminating obstacles for their leader, Atian (played by An Zhi Jie), in prison. Ashan approaches Atian, gains his trust, and collects evidence against the criminal group. After both of them are released from prison, Ashan assists Atian in rising within the criminal organization in Hong Kong. After enduring numerous challenges, Atian successfully replaces the group's leader, Bao Ge (played by Zeng Zhiwei), becoming the new boss and taking control of the organization. However, just as Ashan is about to complete his mission, his true identity is exposed.

programme.desc: The film's story unfolds in the fictional country of Laika and in Hong Kong, China. A police academy student who has not yet graduated, Ashan (played by Gu Bin), is tasked with a dangerous mission. He helps the criminal organization by eliminating obstacles for their leader, Atian (played by An Zhi Jie), in prison. Ashan approaches Atian, gains his trust, and collects evidence against the criminal group. After both of them are released from prison, Ashan assists Atian in rising within the criminal organization in Hong Kong. After enduring numerous challenges, Atian successfully replaces the group's leader, Bao Ge (played by Zeng Zhiwei), becoming the new boss and taking control of the organization. However, just as Ashan is about to complete his mission, his true identity is exposed.

programme.title: Morphle
programme.desc: Mila's dad runs the only magic pet store in the city - a fantastical place where you can find all sorts of cute and quirky pets who each have their own unique magic powers, and he has gifted Mila the most magic pet of all, Morphle.

programme.title: Morphle
programme.desc: Ayah Mila mengelola satu-satunya toko hewan peliharaan ajaib di kota ini - tempat yang fantastis di mana Anda bisa menemukan berbagai macam hewan peliharaan yang lucu dan unik, yang masing-masing memiliki kekuatan sihir yang unik, dan dia telah menghadiahkan hewan peliharaan paling ajaib untuk Mila, yaitu Morphle.

programme.title: WAKAKIBO KIDS
programme.desc: AT THE BASE OF BANANA MOUNTAIN, RIGHT ON THE EDGE OF A FANTASY TROPICAL FOREST FILLED WITH VARIOUS CUTE AND ADORABLE ANIMALS, LIES THE VILLAGE WHERE OUR TWO FRIENDS LIVE: WAKA AND KIBO. WAKA, A CHILD WHO LOVES TO EAT AND LOOKS LIKE A SLOW CHILD, IS ACTUALLY VERY CAREFUL AND ALWAYS THINKING BEFORE HE ACTS. ON THE OTHER HAND, KIBO, WITH HIS THICK, CURRY HAIR, IS A CHEERFUL FIGURE, ALWAYS CURIOS, AND EASY TO MAKE FRIENDS WITH ANYONE. UNLIKE WAKA, KIBO OFTEN ACTS WITHOUT THINKING FIRST. THE STORY OF FRIENDSHIP BETWEEN WAKA AND KIBO IN THEIR VILLAGE FULL OF COLOUR AND LIFE TAKES US ON ENTERTAINING AND FASCINATING ADVENTURES, WHERE THESE TWO CHARACTERS LEARN FROM THEIR DIFFERENCES AND COMPLEMENT EACH OTHER.

programme.title: WAKAKIBO KIDS
programme.desc: DI DASAR GUNUNG PISANG, TEPAT DI PINGGIRAN HUTAN TROPIS FANTASI YANG DIPENUHI DENGAN BERBAGAI HEWAN LUCU DAN MENGGEMASKAN, TERLETAKLAH DESA TEMPAT TINGGAL DUA SAHABAT KITA: WAKA DAN KIBO. WAKA, SEORANG ANAK YANG GEMAR MAKAN DAN TERLIHAT SEPERTI ANAK YANG LAMBAN, SEBENARNYA SANGAT HATI-HATI DAN SELALU BERPIKIR SEBELUM BERTINDAK. DI SISI LAIN, KIBO, DENGAN RAMBUT KERITING TEBALNYA, ADALAH SOSOK YANG CERIA, SELALU INGIN TAHU, DAN MUDAH BERTEMAN DENGAN SIAPA PUN. BERBEDA DENGAN WAKA, KIBO SERING KALI BERTINDAK TANPA BERPIKIR TERLEBIH DAHULU. KISAH PERSAHABATAN ANTARA WAKA DAN KIBO DI DESA MEREKA YANG PENUH WARNA DAN KEHIDUPAN MEMBAWA KITA PADA PETUALANGAN-PETUALANGAN YANG MENGHIBUR DAN MEMUKAU, DI MANA KEDUA KARAKTER INI BELAJAR DARI PERBEDAAN MEREKA DAN SALING MELENGKAPI SATU SAMA LAIN.

programme.title: TITIPO TITIPO
programme.desc: LITTLE TRAIN TITIPO, NEWBORN IN CHOO CHOO TOWN, JUST PASSED HIS DRIVING EXAM AND IS READY TO WORK IN THE RAILWAY VILLAGE. ALTHOUGH TITIPO DREAMS OF BECOMING THE BEST TRAIN IN THE WORLD, HIS CURIOUS PERSONALITY ALWAYS LEADS HIM TO UNEXPECTED EVENTS AND PROBLEMS EVERY DAY. TITIPO EXPANDS HIS EXPERIENCE IN A BIGGER WORLD AND BECOMES FRIENDS WITH GENIE, DIESEL, AND OTHER LITTLE TRAINS. WILL TITIPO ACHIEVE HIS DREAM OF BECOMING THE BEST TRAIN? JOIN THE TRAIN JOURNEY AND MEET TITIPO AND THE LITTLE TRAIN FRIENDS.

programme.title: TITIPO TITIPO
programme.desc: KERETA LITTLE TITIPO YANG BARU LAHIR DI KOTA CHOO CHOO BARU SAJA LULUS UJIAN MENGEMUDI DAN SIAP BEKERJA DI DESA KERETA API. MESKIPUN TITIPO BERMIMPI MENJADI KERETA TERBAIK DI DUNIA, KEPRIBADIANNYA YANG PENASARAN MEMBUATNYA SELALU BERADA DI DALAM PERISTIWA DAN MASALAH YANG TIDAK TERDUGA SETIAP HARI. TITIPO MEMPERLUAS PENGALAMANNYA DI DUNIA YANG LEBIH BESAR DAN BERTEMAN DENGAN GENIE, DIESEL, DAN KERETA KECIL LAINNYA. AKANKAH TITIPO MENCAPAI MIMPINYA MENJADI KERETA TERBAIK? BERGABUNGLAH DENGAN PERJALANAN KERETA API DAN TEMUI TITIPO DAN TEMAN -TEMAN KERETA KECIL.

programme.title: KATURI
programme.desc: Katuri is an exciting show about four peacock chicks growing up in a natural forest under the gentle care and affection of Mother Flora. Mother Flora always encourages her children to explore the world with other animals and helps them whenever they need it. When the peacock chicks encounter difficulties or even danger, Mother Flora is always there to keep them safe.

programme.title: KATURI
programme.desc: Katuri adalah sebuah acara menarik tentang empat anak burung pegar yang tumbuh di hutan alami di bawah perawatan dan kasih sayang lembut ibu flora. Ibu flora selalu mendorong anak-anaknya untuk menjelajahi dunia bersama hewan lain dan membantu mereka kapan pun mereka membutuhkan. Ketika anak-anak burung merak mengalami kesulitan atau bahkan bahaya, ibu flora selalu ada untuk menjaga mereka tetap aman.

programme.title: PORORO, THE LITTLE PENGUIN
programme.desc: Pororo the little penguin and his friends live in a peaceful land covered in snow and ice. They all have different personalities and interests, which sometimes cause a little trouble in their quiet winter world. But together, every day is an adventure where they learn all of life's lessons, big and small!

programme.title: PORORO, THE LITTLE PENGUIN
programme.desc: Pororo si penguin kecil dan teman -temannya tinggal di tanah yang damai yang ditutupi salju dan es. Mereka semua memiliki kepribadian dan minat yang berbeda, yang terkadang menyebabkan sedikit masalah di dunia musim dingin yang tenang. tetapi selalu bersama-sama, setiap hari adalah petualangan di mana mereka belajar semua pelajaran hidup, baik besar maupun kecil !

programme.title: SHUKE AND BEITA
programme.desc: Two mice, Shuke and Beta, become partners and embark on amazing adventures. They help other animals with their helicopter and tank, gaining love and friendship along the way.

programme.title: SHUKE AND BEITA
programme.desc: DUA TIKUS, SHUKE DAN BETA, MENJADI MITRA DAN MEMULAI PETUALANGAN YANG MENAKJUBKAN. MEREKA MEMBANTU HEWAN LAIN DENGAN HELIKOPTER DAN TANK MEREKA DAN MENERIMA CINTA DAN PERSAHABATAN SEPANJANG PERJALANAN MEREKA.

programme.title: BLUEY
programme.desc: Bluey is an Australian animated series that follows the daily adventures of a six-year-old blue heeler puppy named Bluey. Together with her younger brother, Bingo, and her parents, Bandit and Chilli, Bluey engages in imaginative games that spark curiosity and creativity.

programme.title: BLUEY
programme.desc: Bluey adalah serial animasi asal australia yang mengikuti petualangan sehari-hari seekor anak anjing ras blue heeler berusia enam tahun bernama bluey. Bersama adiknya, bingo, serta kedua orang tuanya, bandit dan chilli, bluey menjalani berbagai permainan imajinatif yang memicu rasa ingin tahu dan kreativitas.

programme.title: TIAN TIAN
programme.desc: A simple family from the big city decides to leave the glitz and glamour of urban life behind and return to the village for the sake of their child, who is afraid to go to school. In the village, they interact with friends, neighbors, and local animals, causing endless awkward and funny situations. However, amid all the silliness, there are also touching moments of togetherness, where laughter and tears go hand in hand. Tiantian, the six-year-old child, full of curiosity and love for the world, begins to develop into a healthy, independent, and confident person amidst the beauty of the countryside.

programme.title: TIAN TIAN
programme.desc: Sebuah keluarga sederhana dari kota besar memutuskan untuk meninggalkan gemerlap perkotaan dan kembali ke desa demi anak mereka yang takut pergi ke sekolah. Di desa, mereka berinteraksi dengan teman, tetangga, dan hewan-hewan sekitar, menyebabkan berbagai situasi canggung dan lucu yang tak berujung. Namun, di tengah-tengah segala kekonyolan itu, juga terjadi momen kebersamaan yang menyentuh hati, di mana tawa dan air mata berdampingan. Tiantian, sang anak yang berusia enam tahun, penuh dengan rasa ingin tahu dan cinta akan dunia, mulai berkembang menjadi pribadi yang sehat, mandiri, dan percaya diri di tengah keindahan pedesaan.

programme.title: ABANG L THE EXPLORER
programme.desc: Abang l the explorer is a variety show that provides entertainment and education. Abang l will invite viewers to play and learn things that are appropriate for his age, with different topics in each episode. Abang L's funny antics, charm, and energy will bring this program to life. The articulate Abang L will ask questions to people around him. He will also try out several professions with the aim of educating viewers about each role.

programme.title: ABANG L THE EXPLORER
programme.desc: Abang l the explorer sebuah veriety show yang memberikan hiburan dan edukasi. Dimana abang l akan mengajak penonton bermain sekaligus belajar hal-hal seusia abang l dan berbeda disetiap episodenya. Tingkah lucu, gemas dan keaktifan abang l akan menjadi warna yang menghidupi program ini. Abang l yang pinter berbicara akan bertanya kepada orang di sekitar abang l. abang l juga akan mencoba beberapa profesi yang bertujuan untuk mengedukasi dari setiap peran profesi tersebut.

programme.title: RAINBOW BUBBLEGEM
programme.desc: In the underwater world, a mermaid named Purple longs for adventures on land and secretly takes a huge risk by transforming herself into a human. With the help of Pink Star, the sleeping guardian fairy of the bubblegem, Purple transforms. However, the excessive use of magic causes the bubblegem, their source of power, to shatter and scatter across the land. To gather the scattered bubblegems, the sea queen White Gold commands seven mermaids from different sea kingdoms.

programme.title: RAINBOW BUBBLEGEM
programme.desc: Di dunia bawah laut, putri duyung bernama purple merindukan petualangan di daratan dan secara diam-diam mengambil risiko besar dengan mengubah dirinya menjadi manusia. Dengan bantuan pink star, peri penjaga bubblegem yang sedang tertidur, purple berubah wujud. Namun, penggunaan sihir yang berlebihan menyebabkan bubblegem, sumber kekuatan mereka, terpotong dan tersebar di daratan. untuk mengumpulkan kembali bubblegem yang tersebar, ratu laut white gold memerintahkan tujuh putri duyung dari kerajaan laut yang berbeda.

programme.title: MAGIC 5 THE ANIMATION
programme.desc: MAGIC 5 THE ANIMATION TELLS THE ADVENTURES OF FIVE SPECIAL TEENS—NAURA, RAHSYA, ADARA, GIBRAN, AND IRSHAD—WHICH ARE FOUND AND CARED FOR BY FATHIR. THESE FIVE CHILDREN HAVE UNIQUE AND DIFFERENT SUPERPOWERS. THEY USE THESE POWERS TO SOLVE VARIOUS CASES AND PROBLEMS THAT OCCUR AROUND THEM. IN ADDITION TO RESCUE MISSIONS, THEY ALSO HAVE TO FACE DAILY CONFLICTS AT SCHOOL, ESPECIALLY FROM THEIR ENEMY GANG, THE BEAST. THIS ANIMATION FOCUS ON THE STORY OF FRIENDSHIP, COHESION, AND THE USE OF SUPERPOWERS FOR GOOD.

programme.title: MAGIC 5 THE ANIMATION
programme.desc: MAGIC 5 THE ANIMATION MENCERITAKAN PETUALANGAN LIMA REMAJA ISTIMEWA—NAURA, RAHSYA, ADARA, GIBRAN, DAN IRSHAD—YANG DITEMUKAN DAN DIASUH OLEH FATHIR.KELIMA ANAK INI MEMILIKI KEKUATAN SUPER YANG UNIK DAN BERBEDA. MEREKA MENGGUNAKAN KEKUATAN TERSEBUT UNTUK MEMECAHKAN BERBAGAI KASUS DAN MASALAH YANG TERJADI DI SEKITAR MEREKA. SELAIN MISI PENYELAMATAN, MEREKA JUGA HARUS MENGHADAPI KONFLIK SEHARI-HARI DI SEKOLAH, TERUTAMA DARI GENG MUSUH MEREKA, THE BEAST. ANIMASI INI BERFOKUS PADA KISAH PERSAHABATAN, KEKOMPAKAN, DAN PENGGUNAAN KEKUATAN SUPER UNTUK KEBAIKAN.

programme.title: NEW KELUARGA SOMAT
programme.desc: FOLLOW THE EXCITING ADVENTURES OF PAK SOMAT'S FAMILY AS THEY STARTED A NEW LIFE IN CITEKO! FROM BUILDING BU INAH'S DREAM STORE, THE EXCITEMENT OF BEING NEIGHBORS WITH CEU KOKOM, TO PAK SOMAT'S STRUGGLE TO BECOME AN ONLINE MOTORCYCLE TAXI FOR THE SAKE OF HIS FAMILY. A WARM STORY FULL OF LAUGHTER AND A MORAL MESSAGE SUITABLE FOR ALL AGES.

programme.title: NEW KELUARGA SOMAT
programme.desc: IKUTI PETUALANGAN SERU KELUARGA PAK SOMAT SAAT MEMULAI HIDUP BARU DI CITEKO! DARI MEMBANGUN WARUNG IMPIAN BU INAH, KEHEBOHAN BERTETANGGA DENGAN CEU KOKOM, HINGGA PERJUANGAN PAK SOMAT MENJADI OJEK ONLINE DEMI KELUARGA. KISAH HANGAT PENUH TAWA DAN PESAN MORAL YANG COCOK UNTUK SEMUA UMUR.

programme.title: POKEMON SEASON 27 HORIZON SEASON 2
programme.desc: LIKO, ROY, AND DOT JOIN NARANJA ACADEMY FOR TERA TRAINING, WHERE THEY MUST FACE VARIOUS GYM LEADERS. DURING THEIR JOURNEY, THEY MEET OLD FRIENDS, MAKE NEW RIVALS, AND FACE THE THREAT OF A GROUP OF EXPLORERS WHO ARE AFTER THE SECRETS OF TERAPAGOS. AS THEY HON THEIR TERASTALS, THEY MUST ALSO FACE THE CHALLENGES OF THE TOURNAMENT AND SUDDEN ATTACKS FROM THE ENEMY.

programme.title: POKEMON SEASON 27 HORIZON SEASON 2
programme.desc: LIKO, ROY, DAN DOT BERGABUNG DENGAN AKADEMI NARANJA UNTUK MENGIKUTI PELATIHAN TERA TRAINING, DI MANA MEREKA HARUS MENGHADAPI BERBAGAI GYM LEADER. SELAMA PERJALANAN, MEREKA BERTEMU DENGAN TEMAN LAMA, RIVAL BARU, SERTA MENGHADAPI ANCAMAN DARI KELOMPOK EXPLORERS YANG MENGINCAR RAHASIA TERAPAGOS. SEMENTARA MEREKA MENGASAH KEKUATAN TERASTAL, MEREKA JUGA HARUS MENGHADAPI TANTANGAN TURNAMEN DAN SERANGAN MENDADAK DARI MUSUH.

programme.title: KELUARGA SOMAT
programme.desc: THE SOMAT FAMILY TELLS THAT WE MUST LIVE SIDE BY SIDE AND HELP EACH OTHER AS A COMMUNITY AND AS STUDENTS.

programme.title: KELUARGA SOMAT
programme.desc: KELUARGA SOMAT MENCERITAKAN BAHWA KITA HIDUP HARUS SALING BERDAMPINGAN DAN MEMBANTU SATU SAMA LAIN SEBAGAI MASYARAKAT MAUPUN PELAJAR.

programme.title: Kiko
programme.desc: Kiko tells of a child of a goldfish who is very independent, even though he is an only child. Kiko who is always cheerful has four good friends, namely Lola the discus fish, Ting Ting the crab, Patino the catfish and Poli the betta fish. On the other hand, the antagonists, Karkus the catfish and Pupus the eel, always make Kiko's life chaotic. One day, the lake where Kiko lives is polluted due to the reckless acts of humans, causing Kiko and friends to turn into mutants.

programme.title: Kiko
programme.desc: Kiko, seekor anak ikan mas koki yang sangat mandiri, walaupun ia anak tunggal. Kiko selalu riang dan memiliki empat sahabat baik yaitu Lola si ikan diskus, Ting Ting si kepiting, Patino si ikan patin dan Poli si ikan cupang. Di sisi lain, sosok antagonis, Karkus si ikan lele dan Pupus si belut, selalu membuat ricuh kehidupan Kiko.

programme.title: Kiko
programme.desc: Kiko tells of a child of a goldfish who is very independent, even though he is an only child. Kiko who is always cheerful has four good friends, namely Lola the discus fish, Ting Ting the crab, Patino the catfish and Poli the betta fish. On the other hand, the antagonists, Karkus the catfish and Pupus the eel, always make Kiko's life chaotic. One day, the lake where Kiko lives is polluted due to the reckless acts of humans, causing Kiko and friends to turn into mutants.

programme.title: Kiko
programme.desc: Kiko, seekor anak ikan mas koki yang sangat mandiri, walaupun ia anak tunggal. Kiko selalu riang dan memiliki empat sahabat baik yaitu Lola si ikan diskus, Ting Ting si kepiting, Patino si ikan patin dan Poli si ikan cupang. Di sisi lain, sosok antagonis, Karkus si ikan lele dan Pupus si belut, selalu membuat ricuh kehidupan Kiko.

programme.title: SUPA STRIKAS
programme.desc: Every time the Supa Strikas play soccer, it's always exciting! They have to compete against other teams that sometimes cheat or have secrets. Shakes and his friends have to be smart to solve mysteries and work together. Through the story of the Supa Strikas, we learn that soccer isn't just about winning, but also about good teamwork, being honest, and not giving up easily. They travel around the world, meet many new friends, and learn to be better every day.

programme.title: SUPA STRIKAS
programme.desc: Setiap kali supa strikas main bola, pasti seru sekali! mereka harus melawan tim-tim lain yang kadang curang atau punya rahasia. Shakes dan teman-temannya harus pintar memecahkan misteri dan bekerja sama. Lewat cerita supa strikas, kita jadi tahu kalau main bola itu bukan cuma tentang menang, tapi juga tentang kerja sama tim yang baik, jadi anak yang jujur, dan tidak mudah menyerah. mereka berkeliling dunia, bertemu banyak teman baru, dan belajar jadi lebih baik setiap harinya.

programme.title: SUPA STRIKAS
programme.desc: Every time the Supa Strikas play soccer, it's always exciting! They have to compete against other teams that sometimes cheat or have secrets. Shakes and his friends have to be smart to solve mysteries and work together. Through the story of the Supa Strikas, we learn that soccer isn't just about winning, but also about good teamwork, being honest, and not giving up easily. They travel around the world, meet many new friends, and learn to be better every day.

programme.title: SUPA STRIKAS
programme.desc: Setiap kali supa strikas main bola, pasti seru sekali! mereka harus melawan tim-tim lain yang kadang curang atau punya rahasia. Shakes dan teman-temannya harus pintar memecahkan misteri dan bekerja sama. Lewat cerita supa strikas, kita jadi tahu kalau main bola itu bukan cuma tentang menang, tapi juga tentang kerja sama tim yang baik, jadi anak yang jujur, dan tidak mudah menyerah. mereka berkeliling dunia, bertemu banyak teman baru, dan belajar jadi lebih baik setiap harinya.

programme.desc: Wildlife: Europe, A Beautiful... takes viewers on a remarkable journey through Europe's most stunning natural habitats. programme.title: Hiyokko
programme.desc: Hiyokko follows Mineko Yatabe, a cheerful young woman who grows up in a farming village in Ibaraki Prefecture during Japan's period of rapid economic growth. When her father mysteriously disappears while working in Tokyo, Mineko leaves her hometown to find him and support her family. Along the way, she works in factories, forms lasting friendships, and experiences the joys and hardships of city life. Through perseverance and kindness, Mineko matures into a strong, independent woman while discovering the importance of family, community, and hope.

programme.title: Hiyokko
programme.desc: Hiyokko mengisahkan Mineko Yatabe, gadis ceria dari sebuah desa pertanian di Prefektur Ibaraki pada masa pertumbuhan ekonomi Jepang tahun 1960-an. Ketika ayahnya menghilang saat bekerja di Tokyo, Mineko memutuskan merantau ke ibu kota untuk mencarinya sekaligus membantu perekonomian keluarga. Selama perjalanannya, ia bekerja di pabrik, menjalin persahabatan baru, dan menghadapi berbagai tantangan kehidupan di kota besar. Dengan semangat pantang menyerah, Mineko belajar tentang arti keluarga, persahabatan, kerja keras, dan harapan di tengah perubahan zaman.

programme.title: Hiyokko
programme.desc: Hiyokko follows Mineko Yatabe, a cheerful young woman who grows up in a farming village in Ibaraki Prefecture during Japan's period of rapid economic growth. When her father mysteriously disappears while working in Tokyo, Mineko leaves her hometown to find him and support her family. Along the way, she works in factories, forms lasting friendships, and experiences the joys and hardships of city life. Through perseverance and kindness, Mineko matures into a strong, independent woman while discovering the importance of family, community, and hope.

programme.title: Hiyokko
programme.desc: Hiyokko mengisahkan Mineko Yatabe, gadis ceria dari sebuah desa pertanian di Prefektur Ibaraki pada masa pertumbuhan ekonomi Jepang tahun 1960-an. Ketika ayahnya menghilang saat bekerja di Tokyo, Mineko memutuskan merantau ke ibu kota untuk mencarinya sekaligus membantu perekonomian keluarga. Selama perjalanannya, ia bekerja di pabrik, menjalin persahabatan baru, dan menghadapi berbagai tantangan kehidupan di kota besar. Dengan semangat pantang menyerah, Mineko belajar tentang arti keluarga, persahabatan, kerja keras, dan harapan di tengah perubahan zaman.

programme.title: The Marsupilamis
programme.desc: The legendary Marsupilamis swap the wild Palombian jungle for an even wilder place: the city. There, twins Jade and Mica find their world turned upside down when their explorer parents entrust them with three mysterious Marsupilami eggs. Once they hatch, the siblings must get creative to keep their new friends hidden after all, no one knows these energetic creatures exist, and predators could be lurking around every corner.

programme.title: The Marsupilamis
programme.desc: Marsupilami yang legendaris meninggalkan hutan belantara Palombia dan pindah ke tempat yang lebih liar lagi: kota. Di sana, si kembar Jade dan Mica mendapati dunia mereka terbalik ketika orang tua mereka yang seorang penjelajah mempercayakan tiga telur Marsupilami misterius kepada mereka. Setelah menetas, kedua saudara ini harus kreatif untuk menyembunyikan teman-teman baru mereka—lagipula, tidak ada yang tahu keberadaan makhluk-makhluk energik ini, dan predator bisa saja mengintai di setiap sudut.

programme.title: L.A. Confidential

programme.title: L.A. Confidential
programme.desc: Seiring dengan meningkatnya korupsi di Los Angeles pada tahun 1950-an, tiga polisi satu yang kaku, satu yang kejam, dan satu yang licik menyelidiki serangkaian pembunuhan dengan cara mereka sendiri dalam menegakkan keadilan.

programme.title: Dante's Peak

programme.desc: Sebuah pengkhianatan mengubah hidup Asti untuk selamanya. Di balik setiap kebenaran yang terungkap, ia harus memilih antara membalas dendam atau memperjuangkan masa depan anak yang menjadi satu-satunya alasan ia bertahan hidup.

programme.title: Venus Online
programme.desc: Produced by Sanlih E-Television, Venus Online is a lifestyle talk show designed for modern audiences seeking inspiration for everyday living. Each episode features celebrity guests, beauty and fashion experts, and professionals discussing current trends, skincare, wellness, relationships, family life, and self-improvement. Blending informative conversations with light-hearted entertainment, the program offers practical tips and fresh perspectives on contemporary lifestyles.

programme.title: Venus Online
programme.desc: Venus Online adalah program talk show gaya hidup dari Sanlih E-Television yang membahas berbagai isu menarik seputar kehidupan modern. Dalam setiap episode, para host bersama bintang tamu dan pakar mengulas tren kecantikan, fashion, kesehatan, hubungan, keluarga, hingga pengembangan diri melalui diskusi yang ringan namun informatif. Dikemas secara interaktif dan menghibur, acara ini memberikan inspirasi sekaligus tips praktis yang dapat diterapkan dalam kehidupan sehari-hari.

programme.title: Girls Tease
programme.desc: Produced by Sanlih E-Television, Girls Tease explores the topics that matter most to today's urban women. Hosted by actress Tien Hsin and entertainer Fabien Yang, each episode brings together celebrity guests, experts, and audience representatives to discuss current trends, youth, beauty, love, fashion, career, and everyday life. Blending practical advice with candid conversations and humor, the program offers an engaging platform where women can exchange experiences and perspectives on modern living.

programme.title: Girls Tease
programme.desc: Diproduksi oleh Sanlih E-Television, Girls Tease adalah program talk show yang mengangkat berbagai topik seputar kehidupan perempuan masa kini. Dipandu oleh Tien Hsin dan Fabien Yang, setiap episode menghadirkan selebritas, pakar, serta perwakilan masyarakat untuk berbagi pengalaman dan berdiskusi mengenai tren kecantikan, fashion, percintaan, karier, kesehatan, hingga berbagai tantangan yang dihadapi perempuan urban. Dikemas dengan suasana santai, interaktif, dan penuh humor, acara ini menyuguhkan informasi sekaligus hiburan yang relevan bagi penonton modern.

programme.title: Love Now
programme.desc: Love Now follows Yang Yi Ru, a successful advertising executive whose workaholic lifestyle worries her family. In an effort to force her to take a vacation, they convince her that she is terminally ill. During her journey, she meets Lan Shi De, and what begins as an unexpected encounter gradually develops into a heartfelt romance. As misunderstandings, family conflicts, and personal challenges arise, the couple learns valuable lessons about love, trust, and living life to the fullest.

programme.title: Love Now
programme.desc: Love Now mengisahkan Yang Yi Ru, seorang eksekutif periklanan yang terlalu fokus pada pekerjaannya hingga membuat keluarga dan sahabatnya khawatir. Demi memaksanya beristirahat, mereka membuatnya percaya bahwa usianya tidak akan lama lagi. Dalam perjalanan yang dijalaninya, Yi Ru bertemu Lan Shi De dan perlahan menjalin hubungan yang penuh kehangatan. Di tengah berbagai kesalahpahaman, konflik keluarga, dan tantangan hidup, keduanya belajar tentang arti cinta, kepercayaan, dan pentingnya menghargai setiap momen dalam kehidupan.

programme.title: Taoyuan Pearl Coast Music Fest.
programme.desc: From Zhuwei Fishing Harbor in Taoyuan to the world, international and local artists come together for a vibrant summer music experience.

programme.title: Taoyuan Pearl Coast Music Fest.
programme.desc: Dari Pelabuhan Perikanan Zhuwei di Taoyuan hingga ke seluruh dunia, seniman internasional dan lokal berkumpul untuk pengalaman musik musim panas yang meriah.

programme.title: Show Biz
programme.desc: Show Biz delivers comprehensive coverage of the entertainment world through the latest celebrity news, exclusive interviews, behind-the-scenes features, and updates on movies, television, music, and lifestyle. The program also highlights upcoming events, industry trends, and inspiring stories from artists and entertainers, providing viewers with a complete overview of the entertainment scene.

programme.title: Show Biz
programme.desc: Show Biz menghadirkan berbagai informasi terkini seputar industri hiburan, mulai dari kabar selebritas, film, serial televisi, musik, hingga gaya hidup. Program ini juga menyuguhkan liputan di balik layar, wawancara eksklusif dengan para artis, serta ulasan mengenai tren dan peristiwa terbaru di dunia entertainment. Dengan penyajian yang ringan dan informatif, Show Biz menjadi sumber informasi bagi penonton yang ingin mengikuti perkembangan industri hiburan.

programme.title: Mammamia
programme.desc: Mammamia! follows the daily adventures of a devoted mother juggling family life and the unpredictable antics of her children. Told with visual comedy and minimal dialogue, each episode presents amusing situations that arise from parenting, household routines, and family relationships. The series uses physical humor and universal family experiences to create entertaining stories suitable for audiences of all ages.

programme.title: Mammamia
programme.desc: Mammamia! mengangkat kisah seorang ibu yang harus menghadapi berbagai peristiwa tak terduga dalam kehidupan sehari-hari bersama keluarganya. Dengan gaya komedi visual yang ringan dan minim dialog, setiap episode menampilkan kejadian-kejadian lucu seputar mengasuh anak, mengurus rumah tangga, dan dinamika keluarga. Humor yang sederhana dan dekat dengan kehidupan sehari-hari menjadikan serial ini menghibur sekaligus mudah dinikmati oleh seluruh anggota keluarga.

programme.title: Battle Tour
programme.desc: Battle Tour is a travel reality program where celebrity teams design and experience travel itineraries based on different themes and budgets. Throughout each episode, the teams visit popular attractions, discover hidden gems, enjoy local cuisine, and share practical travel tips. programme.title: Hot Door Night

programme.title: The Sound Of Happiness
programme.desc: The Sound of Happiness follows the Wu family, led by a respected police officer and his supportive wife. Although he once dreamed of having a son to continue the family legacy, he instead dedicates his life to guiding his four daughters through the joys and hardships of adulthood. As their lives become intertwined with romance, ambition, betrayal, and family rivalries, the family faces countless trials that test their love and resilience. Blending heartfelt relationships with dramatic twists, the series delivers an emotional story about family bonds, forgiveness, and perseverance.

programme.title: The Sound Of Happiness
programme.desc: The Sound of Happiness mengisahkan keluarga Wu yang dipimpin oleh seorang perwira polisi beserta istrinya. Meski awalnya berharap memiliki seorang putra, mereka justru dikaruniai empat anak perempuan yang masing-masing menghadapi perjalanan hidup dan kisah cinta yang berbeda. Seiring berjalannya waktu, keluarga ini harus menghadapi berbagai konflik, mulai dari perselingkuhan, persaingan, ambisi, hingga rahasia yang menguji hubungan mereka. Di tengah berbagai cobaan tersebut, kasih sayang keluarga dan tekad untuk saling melindungi menjadi kekuatan utama dalam menghadapi setiap tantangan kehidupan.

programme.title: The Tradition Story Of Taiwan
programme.desc: Discover the fascinating traditions and folklore of Taiwan in The Tradition Story of Taiwan. Combining storytelling with visits to historical sites and local communities, the program offers viewers an engaging journey through Taiwan's diverse cultural heritage and enduring traditions.

programme.title: The Tradition Story Of Taiwan

programme.title: Battle Tour

programme.title: The Sound Of Happiness
programme.desc: The Sound of Happiness follows the Wu family, led by a respected police officer and his supportive wife. Although he once dreamed of having a son to continue the family legacy, he instead dedicates his life to guiding his four daughters through the joys and hardships of adulthood. As their lives become intertwined with romance, ambition, betrayal, and family rivalries, the family faces countless trials that test their love and resilience. Blending heartfelt relationships with dramatic twists, the series delivers an emotional story about family bonds, forgiveness, and perseverance.

programme.title: The Sound Of Happiness
programme.desc: The Sound of Happiness mengisahkan keluarga Wu yang dipimpin oleh seorang perwira polisi beserta istrinya. Meski awalnya berharap memiliki seorang putra, mereka justru dikaruniai empat anak perempuan yang masing-masing menghadapi perjalanan hidup dan kisah cinta yang berbeda. Seiring berjalannya waktu, keluarga ini harus menghadapi berbagai konflik, mulai dari perselingkuhan, persaingan, ambisi, hingga rahasia yang menguji hubungan mereka. Di tengah berbagai cobaan tersebut, kasih sayang keluarga dan tekad untuk saling melindungi menjadi kekuatan utama dalam menghadapi setiap tantangan kehidupan.

programme.title: The Tradition Story Of Taiwan

Combining storytelling with visits to historical sites and local communities, the program offers viewers an engaging journey through Taiwan's diverse cultural heritage and enduring traditions.

programme.title: The Tradition Story Of Taiwan
programme.desc: The Tradition Story of Taiwan menyajikan berbagai kisah legenda, cerita rakyat, adat istiadat, kepercayaan tradisional, dan sejarah lokal yang membentuk identitas budaya Taiwan. programme.title: Taste Of Life
programme.desc: Taste of Life follows the Zhao family, owners of a century-old soy sauce business built on tradition and hard work. As the aging patriarch searches for a successor, his children become entangled in complicated relationships, family rivalries, business conflicts, and personal ambitions. Amid romance, heartbreak, betrayal, and redemption, every family member must decide whether to preserve their family's legacy or pursue their own dreams. Through its emotional storytelling, the series celebrates perseverance, forgiveness, and the enduring strength of family bonds.

programme.title: Taste Of Life
programme.desc: Taste of Life mengisahkan keluarga Zhao, pemilik usaha kecap tradisional yang telah diwariskan selama beberapa generasi. Ketika sang kepala keluarga mulai mencari penerus usahanya, setiap anggota keluarga dihadapkan pada pilihan sulit antara mempertahankan tradisi atau mengejar ambisi pribadi. Di tengah konflik bisnis, kisah cinta, perselingkuhan, pengorbanan, dan rahasia keluarga, mereka belajar bahwa kebersamaan, ketekunan, dan kasih sayang adalah fondasi utama untuk menghadapi setiap tantangan hidup.

programme.title: SOLEIL, UN BUSINESS BIEN DORÉ
programme.desc: The sun is essential to life, but it has also become the driving force behind a vast global industry. Through an in-depth investigation, this documentary explores the lucrative sunscreen market, estimated to be worth more than €9 billion worldwide. From marketing claims and protection ratings to environmental concerns and public health recommendations, the film examines whether consumers are truly receiving the protection they are promised. It also investigates the ecological impact of sunscreen products on marine ecosystems and questions the responsibility of manufacturers in balancing health, profit, and sustainability.

programme.title: SOLEIL, UN BUSINESS BIEN DORÉ
programme.desc: Matahari merupakan sumber kehidupan, tetapi juga menjadi fondasi bagi industri perlindungan matahari yang bernilai lebih dari 9 miliar euro di seluruh dunia. Melalui investigasi mendalam, dokumenter ini menelusuri berbagai aspek bisnis sunscreen, mulai dari klaim pemasaran, tingkat perlindungan yang sebenarnya, hingga dampaknya terhadap kesehatan dan lingkungan. Film ini mempertanyakan apakah produk yang beredar benar-benar memberikan perlindungan sesuai yang dijanjikan, sekaligus menyoroti konsekuensi ekologis dari penggunaan produk tabir surya terhadap lautan dan ekosistemnya. Di tengah meningkatnya suhu global dan kesadaran akan kesehatan kulit, dokumenter ini mengungkap sisi tersembunyi dari sebuah bisnis yang terus berkembang pesat.

programme.title: GBRB: Farm Operation, Ep 6

programme.title: Mr. Eo's Food World Tour, Ep 5

programme.title: Undercover Chef: Korea, Ep 10
programme.desc: Chefs Kwon Sung Jun, Jung Ji Sun, and Sam Kim are widely recognized figures in South Korea’s culinary world. Although they are now celebrated chefs, it has been a long time since they last worked as junior cooks in a professional kitchen. To prove that their skills remain as sharp as ever, the three are sent to countries that inspired their cooking styles, where they go undercover as entry-level kitchen staff. The challenge does not end there: they have only five days to impress their superiors and create a signature dish worthy of being added to the restaurant’s menu. Will their experience and expertise be enough to achieve success, or will they crumble under the pressure?

programme.title: Undercover Chef: Korea, Ep 10

To prove that their skills remain as sharp as ever, the three are sent to countries that inspired their cooking styles, where they go undercover as entry-level kitchen staff. Will their experience and expertise be enough to achieve success, or will they crumble under the pressure?

programme.title: Legend Of Kitchen Soldier, Ep 5
programme.desc: The Legend of Kitchen Soldier follows Kang Seong-jae, a young man from a humble background who joins the army after losing his father. Although he excels during training, he is assigned to work in the military kitchen due to his experience helping at his father's food truck. One day, a mysterious virtual interface appears before him and begins assigning cooking-related missions. As he completes each challenge, his culinary skills improve dramatically, earning the respect of fellow soldiers and superiors alike. Alongside the humor and camaraderie of military life, Seong-jae gradually uncovers hidden secrets connected to his father's death. Blending military comedy, fantasy, and food-themed storytelling, the series delivers an uplifting tale of perseverance, friendship, and self-discovery.

programme.title: Legend Of Kitchen Soldier, Ep 5
programme.desc: The Legend of Kitchen Soldier mengisahkan Kang Seong-jae, seorang pemuda dari keluarga sederhana yang memutuskan masuk militer setelah kematian ayahnya. Meski menjadi lulusan terbaik selama pelatihan, ia justru ditempatkan di bagian dapur karena pengalamannya membantu usaha food truck milik sang ayah. Kehidupannya berubah ketika sebuah sistem misterius layaknya permainan video muncul dan memberinya berbagai misi memasak. Setiap tantangan yang berhasil diselesaikan membuat kemampuan memasaknya berkembang pesat hingga ia menjadi sosok yang dihormati oleh rekan-rekan dan atasannya. Di balik kisah penuh humor dan semangat kebersamaan di barak militer, Seong-jae juga perlahan menemukan petunjuk tentang rahasia yang mungkin berkaitan dengan kematian ayahnya. Serial ini memadukan komedi, fantasi, dunia kuliner, dan kisah pertumbuhan diri dalam sebuah petualangan yang menghibur dan hangat.

programme.title: You Can Cook, Sam Kim, Ep 12
programme.desc: Star chef Sam Kim will teach you how to make all kinds of delicious dishes, from Italian pasta, Spanish food to desserts! Follow his easy recipes and enjoy cooking!

programme.title: What A Man Wants
programme.desc: Set on Jeju Island, What a Man Wants follows Seok-geun, a cheerful taxi driver known for his flirtatious lifestyle despite being married. Convinced that romance and excitement are essential to life, he influences his brother-in-law Bong-soo, a devoted husband who unexpectedly becomes attracted to another woman. As secret relationships, temptations, and misunderstandings begin to intertwine, the characters are forced to confront the consequences of their choices. Combining humor with emotional insight, the film explores marriage, fidelity, desire, and the complexities of modern relationships.

programme.title: What A Man Wants
programme.desc: Berlatar di Pulau Jeju, What a Man Wants mengisahkan Seok-geun, seorang sopir taksi yang terkenal karena sifatnya yang genit meskipun telah menikah. Ia percaya bahwa romansa dan sensasi baru adalah bagian penting dalam hidup. Pandangan tersebut perlahan memengaruhi Bong-soo, adik iparnya yang setia kepada istrinya namun mulai tergoda oleh kehadiran perempuan lain. Ketika hubungan-hubungan rahasia dan berbagai godaan mulai memengaruhi kehidupan mereka, para tokoh harus menghadapi konsekuensi dari pilihan yang mereka buat. Dengan perpaduan komedi dan drama romantis, film ini membahas cinta, kesetiaan, pernikahan, dan dinamika hubungan orang dewasa secara ringan namun penuh makna.

programme.desc: Sarah and Ransh share a common passion for car racing and often race together. When their mutual friend Aditya decides to propose to Sarah, he meets with a car crash and dies, leaving her depressed.

programme.title: Machine
programme.desc: Sarah dan Ransh sama-sama menggemari balap mobil dan sering berlomba bersama. Teman mereka, Aditya, memutuskan untuk melamar Sarah, tapi ia mengalami kecelakaan mobil dan meninggal. Hal ini pun membuat Sarah depresi.

programme.desc: Pada suatu malam saat terjadi badai, Aman mendapatkan kekuatan dari pohon suci kala ia berkelahi dengan Raka. Ia pun tumbuh menjadi sesosok pahlawan super bernama Flying Jat untuk membantu orang-orang yang membutuhkan.

programme.desc: An alcoholic professor is sent to a juvenile school, where he clashes with a gangster who uses the school children for criminal activities.
